description: Awarding Contracts for Ground Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines at the Dubai Airport in the United Arab Emirates
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-04-20 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- SriLankan Airlines Limited currently operates scheduled passenger and cargo flights to the Dubai Airport. The Standard Ground Handling Services Agreement signed between SriLankan Airlines and Dnata, the sole provider of ground handling services at the Dubai Airport, for the provision of passenger and ramp handling services, has expired on 2026.03.31. The Standard Ground Handling Services Agreement signed between SriLankan Airlines and Dnata for the supply of cargo warehouse handling services is scheduled to expire on 2026.06.30. The Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Ports and Civil Aviation to award the relevant contracts as follows, based on the recommendations of the Bid Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee:

*	To award the contract for the Passenger and Ramp Handling Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Dubai Airport for an estimated cost of AED 33.04 million, for a period of 03 years (from 2026-04-01 to 2029-03-31), to Dnata.

* 	To award the contract for the Cargo and Warehouse Services of SriLankan Airlines Limited at the Dubai Airport to an estimated cost of AED 7.6 million, for a period of 03 years (from 2026.07.01 to 2029.06.30), to Dnata.
